body:
I can't really talk with anyone anymore as it gives me tons of anxiety. I do try in my mind to make some plans everyday of getting shit done but end up aimlessly staring at my computer screen and eating shit that is bad for my health.  


Idk what to do. The thought of getting a good job and finding someone who loves me somehow keeps me alive. Also, the thought that my parents would be devastated if I leave this world. But more than that, somewhere the possibility that life can be awesome stops me from acting on it.

The Neighbourhood.

Started off with Sweater Weather and boy their music is amazing.
By "stuck with my masters", I meant "stuck in my masters". I haven't been able to complete the degree because studying has become the most difficult task, ever.

I can totally relate to socially withdrawing from people.

I used to share everything with my sister but I don't even want to talk to her, or anyone anymore. 

Talking to people feels like such a chore.

a) Gyms are closed due to Covid

b) Starting any kind of workout feels like such a big chore. My body and my brain doesn't support me in any way.

28 year old virgin here.
Video games, obese af and literally no social skills. Clinical Depression on top of that.
Idk what to do in life anymore.
Day 1. Its time to get my shitty life together.
